description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a hyper‑frame structural block containing multi‑tier frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::HYPERFRAME-ALPHA

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [HYPER-ALPHA]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HA1
    TIER::PRIMARY

  [HYPER-BETA]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::HB1
    TIER::SECONDARY

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    HYPERSET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    HYPERSET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-HYPERFRAME-ALPHA}
  HF9-HE8-HD7-HC6

<END-HYPERFRAME-ALPHA>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire hyperframe‑alpha block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
